requirement.description: The base plugin class is missing several required imports including is_email, parse_list, and validate_regex functions that are used by various plugins. This causes ImportError when plugins try to use these utilities.
requirement.contract: Add missing imports for utility functions (is_email, parse_list, validate_regex) to the base plugin class so that child plugins can access them without ImportError.

requirement.description: The Apprise class has issues with proper instantiation of notification objects. Tests show isinstance checks are failing for NotifyBase objects, indicating the objects aren't being created properly.
requirement.contract: Fix the Apprise class to properly instantiate notification objects from URLs and ensure isinstance checks work correctly for NotifyBase instances.

requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin has issues with URL parsing and handling of group/user expansion. Some tests expect specific behaviors that aren't implemented properly.
requirement.contract: Implement proper URL parsing and handling of group/user expansion for Nextcloud notifications. Ensure that group resolution and caching work correctly according to the test expectations.

requirement.description: The Resend plugin has issues with URL parsing and notification response handling. Some URL formats aren't being processed correctly and edge cases aren't handled.
requirement.contract: Fix URL parsing in the Resend plugin to handle various URL formats correctly and implement proper validation for API keys and email addresses.

requirement.description: The SendGrid plugin has issues with email validation and notification response handling. Some email addresses are incorrectly rejected and notification responses aren't handled properly.
requirement.contract: Correct email validation in SendGrid plugin to properly accept valid email addresses and ensure notification responses are handled correctly according to test expectations.
